scope_notes: This is a snapshot seed contract, not a claim these transitions were executed. Each seed is isolated and reset.
Proposed source/index tables belong to Catalog/Support within the same PostgreSQL database; reconcile actual DDL before preparation.
Policy effective dates and renewal period are synthetic fixture dates, not current or promised coverage. Renewal eligibility window is pinned by the fixture.

Mock-order original amount stays immutable; the extra 10000 capture is linked to its separate adjustment allocation. Order enum values are proposed teaching-schema values pending code-owner reconciliation.
Timeline rows are a bounded selected evidence fixture, not a complete lifetime audit history; actual implementation must preserve all produced events.
Posted journal entries are immutable. Wallet credit40000 minus active reservation5000 gives available35000; reservation is not a debit.
Old capstone-logical-v1 and 3/6/2/3 generic archive are retained byte-for-byte with original names/hashes and are not CoverStory evidence.
New journey/audit/analytics/envelope tables augment the recovered domain; they are new user requirements, not recovered ECOS implementation evidence.

ApplicationRevision preserves its composite (application_id,revision) key. Journey uses (application_id,application_revision) as a composite foreign key; envelopes bind application UUID plus revision. No revision UUID or rekey is introduced.
Journey current_step/status use the new proposed bounded enum registry v1; no browser state setter is introduced.

Encryption fields are null because actual test encryption has not been prepared. This is deliberately not a valid restore archive until the instructor materializes AEAD bytes, wrapped keys and manifests, keeping ephemeral KEKs separate.
The failed renewal attempt does not add captured funds or consume the5000reservation. Explicit recovery/release policy is a separate tested command.

Analytics 7 days is a teaching retention example, not legal advice. A null expiry in this proposed seed means the required retention decision is pending, never unlimited retention. Financial/audit retention and holds remain separately configured and reviewed.
integrity_requirements: Validate every declared table count, primary/foreign key, owner mapping and exact immutable-content hash.
Validate A original/revised terms lineage, exact accepted quote/configuration, unique allocation effects and provider references.
Validate no policy without simulated issuance reference plus effective-cover evidence; cancellation has no submission record.
Validate renewal links a new application to prior policy; prior policy and accepted original facts are unchanged.
Validate source citation version/offset and assistance release compatibility. Hash/count agreement is necessary but not sufficient.
Actual command outputs, timing, backup hash, schema/commit and per-check PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN must be recorded only when executed.
Restore all five new tables and domain envelope references; ensure no duplicate mutable plaintext draft exists on journey.
For every owner A/B journey, validate actual application/revision/quote ownership, stable server sequence and safe resume projection.
Retained key version must be available to authorized recovery; unavailable key fails readiness instead of returning empty/plaintext data.
Audit observations link the actual unique money effect and retain UNKNOWN/reconciliation/FAILED history; analytics rows never prove business progression.
